name: e2e-suite
description: Community marketplace for the e2e-suite project: self-evolving front/back-end test skill family + platform-agnostic test gate. Add this marketplace in your client, then install either plugin.

description_i18n.zh-CN: e2e-suite 社区插件市场：自进化前后端联动测试技能家族 + 平台无关测试门禁。在客户端添加本市场后即可安装其中插件。

plugins.name: e2e-suite-skills
plugins.description: Self-evolving e2e test skill family: a contract-based orchestrator that dynamically discovers and schedules member skills across env/design/exec/assert/report/canary slots — joint front/back-end testing, negative paths, persistence boundaries, UX acceptance, visual regression, API contract diff, performance probing, whitebox suites, canary self-evolution, and harness-scaffold (a blueprint that generates a reusable test harness for any project). Pure methodology skills, zero runtime hooks.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 自进化前后端联动测试技能家族：契约式总控动态发现并调度 env/design/exec/assert/report/金丝雀 各槽位成员——联动测试、负向路径、持久化边界、UX 验收、视觉回归、API 契约比对、性能探针、白盒套件、金丝雀自进化，以及 harness-scaffold（为任意项目生成可复用测试脚手架的蓝图）。纯方法论技能，无运行时 hook。

plugins.name: test-gate
plugins.description: Automated test gate v0.2: hooks enforce Stop gating (auto baseline lifecycle + flaky quarantine with rerun detection + regression blocking), TIA affected-test selection for pytest/go, MCP exposes status/run/reset, gate-preflight joins the e2e-suite family (env slot) gating E2E runs on green unit layer. Auto-detects test stacks, zero per-project config. gate-core is platform-agnostic with a CLI entry for any host.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 自动测试门禁 v0.2：hook 收工把关（基线全自动生命周期+抖动重跑隔离+回归拦截），pytest/go 影响面选择跑测，MCP 三工具，gate-preflight 以 env 槽接入 e2e 家族（联动开跑先过单元闸）。自动检测测试栈，新项目零配置。判定引擎平台无关，带任意宿主可用的 CLI。
